about: Grey Highlands is a municipality in Grey County, Ontario, covering Markdale, Flesherton, and surrounding Escarpment countryside—not a single city. Beaver Valley approaches, highland farms, and village centres inland from Georgian Bay define the community. About 10,000 people live in Grey Highlands.
